discovery.input_zh: 权威控制源 main 提交 8067d6e8c4d7ef06a6298b398dbdf9576caf9f83、Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Discovery Prompt v1.1.0、同一控制源提交上的全部 10 个 requiredSources、已核验的 2026-09-02 Wake Receipt、仅用于增量去重与样本轮换的 2026-09-01 Intelligence Run，以及原 Discovery 执行轮次在控制面 Lease 过期前已经持久化的同日 Intelligence Artifact。
discovery.workResult: The original 09:03 Discovery epoch produced the same-date Intelligence artifact but never durably closed its Runtime state. At the Analysis wake, global reconciliation found Discovery still Running, expired the stale 45-minute lease, deferred Analysis, reopened Discovery as the earliest due unfinished task, and claimed a recovery worker. Recovery did not replace or regenerate the existing evidence pool: it re-fetched the 2026-09-02 artifact, confirmed it was already Completed, and verified its original persistence commit ca0c7250d99fcc2661a96dd5c0cd752dec207880 had passed Validate Research Center 3.0 run 33579076620 successfully. The artifact records all 45/45 P0 platform channels resolved, all 9/9 P0 daily repositories checked, and all nine P0 research sources resolved as eight checked plus one explicit JSS retrieval failure. It retains 11 normalized signals (3 platform/governance, 5 engineering, 3 primary-research), persists theme-sample-v1 coverage with a 30-day research window, and contains no topic selection. The recovery worker also re-read the Discovery control sources and independently rechecked representative current public sources only to verify that the durable same-date artifact remained plausible; those checks were not used to overwrite the authoritative artifact. No Queue selection, Deep Reading, Research Analysis, article work, Production or Publication was performed during Discovery recovery.
discovery.workResult_zh: 原 09:03 Discovery 执行轮次已经生成并持久化同日 Intelligence Artifact，但没有把 Runtime 控制状态持久收口。Analysis Wake 到达后，全局 Reconciliation 发现 Discovery 仍为 Running，按 45 分钟 Lease 将旧执行轮次判为过期，延后 Analysis，并把 Discovery 作为最早到期未完成任务重新打开执行槽，由恢复 Worker 接管。恢复过程没有替换或重新生成既有 Evidence Pool：重新 Fetch 2026-09-02 Artifact，确认其已经是 Completed，并核验其原始持久化提交 ca0c7250d99fcc2661a96dd5c0cd752dec207880 对应的 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 33579076620 已成功。该 Artifact 记录 AI Platform 45/45 个 P0 公共通道全部收口、GitHub Engineering 9/9 个 P0 Daily 仓库全部检查、Published Research 的 9 个 P0 来源收口为 8 个已检查 + 1 个明确 JSS 抓取失败；共保留 11 个规范化信号（3 个平台/治理、5 个工程、3 个一手研究），持久化 theme-sample-v1 与 30 天研究窗口，且没有执行选题。恢复 Worker 还重新读取 Discovery 控制源，并仅对部分当前公共来源做代表性复核，用于确认同日持久 Artifact 仍然合理；这些复核没有覆盖或改写权威 Artifact。Discovery 恢复期间未执行 Queue 选题、Deep Reading、Research Analysis、文章工作、Production 或 Publication。
